name: Tilted gimbal
about: The same three motors, but the first axis points up, slightly back and outward. Gimbal lock then sits just outside the arm's reach: raised overhead slightly behind the body, or pointing into the chest. The centre still stays fixed while the real shoulder joint moves.
design_note: First axis, J2 side and motor ring radius picked by a design search over the shoulder range sweep (2026-10-08): the side keeps the middle motor outside the head and neck, and both gimbal-lock directions sit just outside the human range (up and slightly behind overhead, and into the chest). J1 and J3 turn up to 270 degrees each way through a cable wrap.
